text: Hello boys and girls, I'm Chris, from Hezhong Primary School.It's time for English class.First, let's learn the sounds.Read after me, please.Look, the girl can fly the kite.Where is she?She's in the garden.There are many children in the garden.Let's go and have a look.Danny, Ben, Eddy, Alice and Peter are in the garden.What are they doing?Let's watch.No, I like skating.No, I like hopping.No, I like riding my bicycle.The children are playing happily in the garden.Look at Danny and Ben.What are they talking about?Listen.Do you like running?Yes, I like running.Ben likes running.Look at Ben, he can run.Read after me, run.You are run.Let's spell, run.Run, running.Follow me, running.In, knee, running.Ben likes running very much.He's saying a chant.Run, run, I can run.Running, running, I like running.Can you try?Ready, go.Good job.Danny meets Ben in the garden.He asks, do you like run or running?So, A or B?这是一句一般语问句,我们要用声调来朗读。Now, let's listen and follow.What does Ben say?Let's try.What about Peter?He's in the garden too.Let's ask with Danny.Peter doesn't like running.He likes skating.Look, how cool.Peter 玩滑板的样子是不是很帅气呢?Peter can skate.So, what's the missing letter?Yes, it's letter A.Follow me.Let's spell.Boys and girls, do you remember this chant?你能学着Ben的样子也帮Peter编一首儿歌吗?Have a try.Look, this is the chant I make.你的儿歌和我的一样吗?You are so clever.Peter, do you like running?Yes, I like skating.Think it over.Bingo!Peter answers.We know Ben likes running and Peter likes skating.Oh, whose that?It's Eddy.Eddy likes hopping.哪一幅图片表示hop呢?Let's try skip.I like skipping very much.Eddie doesn't like skipping.He likes hopping.Pay attention.One more time.Eddie is hopping.He is so happy.Now let's sing a happy song with Eddie.Shall we?One, two, three.I like hopping.So happy.Wow, you can sing very well.Now let's think.What does Danny and Eddie say in the garden?Now you try.Good.What can you hear?A bicycle?It's Alice.Do you remember Danny's question?Now let's ask.Do you like?I like riding my bicycle.Alice likes riding her bicycle.Look.Ride.I ride.Ride my bicycle.Bye-bye, E.Riding.Alice is playing a game in the garden.Alice正在花园里面玩闯关游戏呢。让我们一起加入她吧。Let's go, Alice.Round 1.Let's read.I like riding.Great, Alice.Go, go, go.Come on.You are so super.Now, Alice.Now, I like riding my bicycle.Today, Danny and his friends are in the garden.They have a good time.What do they like doing?Let's watch the video again.Do Danny's friends like running?What will they say?Please think and choose.The following sentence can help you.Let's check.I am Danny and you are the children.Ben, do you like running?Eddie, do you like running?Alice, do you like running?Good job, boys and girls.We like doing different things.Maybe running, maybe hopping.Maybe singing, dancing or writing.Now, let's enjoy a lovely song.I like dancing.Write, write, write with me.I like writing.Boys and girls, do you like this song?I like it too.In today's class, we knowPeter likes skating.Eddie likes hopping.Alice likes riding a bicycle.And do you remember?小朋友們,當我們想知道同伴是否喜歡做某件事的時候你可以這樣問Do you like?
